verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's GitHub README lists GraphQL (gh-9) and describes full-duplex channels over a single TCP connection, which is the WebSocket feature (gh-4). Both are only one-line descriptions with no detailed docs. The pack has no evidence for gRPC or SSE, so only about half the story is supported. missing for 10: gRPC request support, SSE (Server-Sent Events) support, in-depth first-party docs for GraphQL and WebSocket clients, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-REST protocols.
